verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a developer-facing terminal app, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only static usage docs with command examples (e.g. ssh/mosh syntax). Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt. Nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
